title: Q7
description:
Read: 2Sa 7:12-16, 1Ch 17:11-14

One form of the promise chastens the seed if he commits iniquity. The other leaves that clause out and establishes the throne forever.

a) House, throne, and forever are in the promise. What do they add that the bare word Son does not?

b) The letter follows the form with no chastening for iniquity. What does that imply about this seed?
